nl: Run tools/slow.py slow with a time limit of 3 seconds (job 1). If it ends in time, write the word finished to status.txt; otherwise stop it and write the word timeout.

entries.content_utf8:
import pathlib
import sys
import time

delay = {"quick": 0.2, "slow": 60}[sys.argv[1]]
time.sleep(delay)
pathlib.Path("out").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
pathlib.Path("out/result.txt").write_text("done\n")
